dedupe_keys.name: non skew bridge with uniform scour

description: Non-skew bridge with uniform scour is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Serenay Ates, Eskisehir Technical University. This project is about the seismic demands of a non-skewed bridge with uniform scour depth. The nonlinear response history analysis were done by using OpenSees. Superstructure displacement, curvature demands of bridge column, shear force demands of bridge column and shear force demands of pile elements were engineering demand parameters for this project. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-ypvx-4817. Keywords: scour; bridge; nonlinear analysis. Published 2024-04-21. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
